title: theway workflow
description: A theway workflow: the ordered steps /theway:workflow runs for a change. theway workflow is the authority for the rules this schema cannot express.

version.description: The format of this file: theway.workflow/v1.

default.description: Whether /theway:workflow runs this workflow when no --workflow is given.

agents.description: Whether the steps run through agents (true, the default) or inline in the session (false), unless an entry sets its own.

steps.description: The entries, in run order: each a step name or gate.

entry.description: One entry: a map with exactly one key, a step name or gate.

gate.description: A question /theway:workflow asks the user before the next entry; any answer but Continue stops the change.

additionalProperties.description: A step, resolved by name from the project's steps folder, else the global one; its value is nothing or a map of agents and the step's params.

anyOf.description: No param set: every param takes its effective default.
agents and the step's params, as literal values.

agents.description: Whether this step runs through agents (true) or inline in the session (false).

items.description: A name: lowercase letters and digits in words separated by single hyphens.

anyOf.description: A non-empty list of names without duplicates.

additionalProperties.description: A param of the step: a string, an integer, a boolean or a non-empty list of names without duplicates, of the kind of its default.
